description: This file contains an HTML document that includes JavaScript code defining a 'Calculator' class extending 'Service', which registers methods 'add' and 'sub', and initializes a service manager to register a calculator service on a specified server.

classes.name: Calculator
classes.description: A class extending 'Service' that provides arithmetic methods 'add' and 'sub' and registers these methods for remote invocation.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds an array of numbers provided in 'params' and returns a Promise with the sum.

methods.name: sub
methods.description: Subtracts the second parameter from the first in 'params' array and returns a Promise with the difference.
